profile.title: Arthur Battram
profile.canonical_definition: A complexity practitioner and author whose work translated complexity ideas into organisational and local-government practice, including Navigating Complexity and the Learning from Complexity materials.
profile.summary: Arthur Battram translated complexity ideas into organisational and local-government practice while resisting both command-and-control simplification and fashionable complexity incantation.
profile.why_it_matters: Battram provides a practical bridge from complexity theory to management action, emphasising navigation, experimentation and judgement rather than the fantasy of complete control.
key_distinctions: complexity as practice resource vs management fashion
common_misreadings: natural management is a complete method
